lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, with the highest density observed between the pectoral fin insertion and the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal blob rows, creating a coordinate-like system where blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersection points across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from a light-reflective upper edge to a darker shadowed lower edge, extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Irregular distribution of approximately 15-20 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters contained within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher spatial density located toward the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense field of diminutive, high-intensity punctate markers concentrated on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit, significantly smaller and more randomly distributed than the organized grid on the lateral flank.
